content: SkillFoundry follows Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), currently the 5.x line. MAJOR=breaking changes, MINOR=new features, PATCH=fixes. See CHANGELOG.md for the authoritative history.
PRDs live in the genesis/ directory. Create them with /prd or copy genesis/TEMPLATE.md, then run /go to validate, generate stories, and implement everything.

The framework installs to 6 platforms: Claude Code (.claude/commands/), GitHub Copilot CLI (.copilot/custom-agents/), Codex (.agents/skills/), Cursor (.cursor/rules/), Gemini (.gemini/skills/), and Grok (.grok/skills/).

The agents/ directory holds ~56 skill/agent definitions plus ~57 shared protocol modules prefixed with an underscore (e.g. agents/_coding-discipline.md). Platform files reference the shared modules rather than duplicating them.
The anti-pattern references live in docs/ (docs/ANTI_PATTERNS_BREADTH.md and docs/ANTI_PATTERNS_DEPTH.md), not in the project root.
Three-layer validation is mandatory: DATABASE -> BACKEND -> FRONTEND. Every full-stack feature must pass all affected layers (real logic, no mocks) before it is done. Run /layer-check to validate.

Shared agent modules use an underscore prefix in agents/ (e.g. agents/_env-preflight-protocol.md, agents/_codemap-preflight-protocol.md, agents/_known-deviations.md) and are included by the platform-specific skill files.

Zero tolerance in production code for: TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, PLACEHOLDER, STUB, MOCK, COMING SOON, WIP, TEMPORARY, Lorem ipsum, NotImplementedError, empty function bodies, and unjustified @ts-ignore. Any of these triggers immediate rejection.

/verify runs the quality gates (banned-pattern scan, SAST, security checks, three-layer, injection scan) against a diff and returns a PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict. Use it as a pre-commit or CI gate on AI-written or hand-written changes.

agents/_known-deviations.md catalogs 171 known LLM failure patterns across 16 categories (Frontend-Backend Contract Mismatches, Authorization, Silent Logic Failures, Supply Chain, Performance, etc.). Agents reference it to avoid common vibe-coding mistakes.

Database rule: pick ONE naming convention per project and enforce it everywhere (snake_case for SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL, PascalCase for MSSQL) — never mix. Match SQL syntax to the actual DB. API array fields default to [] (never null/undefined); always guard before .map()/.filter()/.some().

Autonomous developer mode is toggled with /autonomous and gated by the flag file .claude/.autonomous. When active, every input is classified (FEATURE/BUG/REFACTOR/QUESTION/OPS/MEMORY) and routed to the correct pipeline automatically.
Shell (bash) chosen over JavaScript for framework tooling. Reason: portability - bash is available everywhere and needs no Node.js runtime for framework operations.
JSONL chosen for knowledge storage. Reasons: append-only (no file locking), line-oriented (grep-friendly), each line is independently valid JSON, and it supports streaming reads.
Agents are authored in Markdown across all platforms for maximum compatibility. Cursor rules (.cursor/rules/*.md) carry no YAML frontmatter; Copilot agents also use .md under .copilot/custom-agents/.
Some Copilot agents are not ported to other platforms because they require GitHub-specific integration (commit-message, github-actions, pr-review, etc.). Platform parity is tracked by /parity.
If /go (or any /command) is not found: the framework is not installed in this project. Run the installer, e.g. /path/to/skillfoundry/install.sh --platform=claude .
If agent/skill counts disagree across docs: the counts are duplicated in README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and docs/ (e.g. QUICK-REFERENCE.md). Update every location or use /parity to detect drift.
If ANTI_PATTERNS files are not at the project root: they were moved to docs/. Look for docs/ANTI_PATTERNS_BREADTH.md and docs/ANTI_PATTERNS_DEPTH.md.

If install.sh aborts with 'cp: cannot stat .../memory_bank/knowledge/bootstrap.jsonl': update to a build where the installer guards the copy. bootstrap.jsonl is an optional seed; as a workaround create an empty one (touch memory_bank/knowledge/bootstrap.jsonl) and re-run the installer.

Never store auth tokens, JWT, or session tokens in localStorage or sessionStorage - they are readable by any XSS. Keep access tokens in memory (SPAs) and refresh tokens in HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict cookies. Rotate refresh tokens on use and revoke on logout.

Never hardcode secrets, API keys, passwords, or connection strings in code. Load all configuration from .env / a secrets manager through a config abstraction. Hardcoded credentials are an automatic rejection.

JWT must use asymmetric algorithms (RS256 or ES256). Never sign JWT with HS256 using a client-accessible secret. Validate signature, expiration (exp), issuer (iss), audience (aud), and required scopes on every protected endpoint.
Passwords must always be hashed and salted with a slow KDF (bcrypt, scrypt, or argon2). Never store or log plaintext passwords. Never put stack traces or secrets in production responses or logs.

Validate and sanitize input at every system boundary. Never build SQL with string concatenation - use parameterized queries. Never execute a shell command or file path derived from external data without validating it first. Verify the working directory and that files exist before running commands.
No feature is done without tests. Minimum coverage: 80% for service/business logic and 100% of API endpoints exercised via a test client. Auth flows must test all roles and token expiry.

Build backend-first, then complete the frontend in the same unit of work. Never ship a backend and ask 'want me to build the UI?' - three-layer completeness (Database, Backend, Frontend) is required before a feature is done. The frontend must call the REAL backend, never mock data.

Before writing any frontend API call, read the actual backend endpoint code and verify the path, HTTP method, request body, and response shape match. Write TypeScript interfaces from the REAL response, not an assumed shape. Frontend-backend contract mismatch is the #1 vibe-coding failure.

Every HTML page uses one shared max-width container so all pages are the same width, includes a width=device-width viewport meta tag, is responsive at 320px / 768px / 1200px, and never produces horizontal scroll. All form fields need labels and a11y attributes.

For auth flows that set cookies via a 302 redirect, use a native form POST, not fetch() - fetch() drops the Set-Cookie header on redirects, so the session cookie is silently lost. This is a recurring, hard-to-debug login failure.

Never silently fail. Log every warning and error, return proper HTTP status codes and messages, and give the user real feedback. When accessing typed objects (Pydantic models, dataclasses), use attribute access (obj.field), not dict access (obj.get('field')).

README.md is user-facing only (installation, usage, quick start). All technical detail - architecture, schemas, breaking changes, migration steps, API changes - goes in CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format) and docs/. Keep them separate.
